recipes.name: Mulled Spiced Apple Cider
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer, partially cover, and let the flavours infuse for 20 to 30 minutes.

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Apple cider does not refer to the alcoholic beverage, but rather, the unfiltered (cloudy) non-alcoholic beverage made from 100% apples.
Storage Best to enjoy immediately. Can be made ahead of time and reheated on the stove. Store in the fridge for up to 1 day.
